Prompt.Prompt: EF-REG-018 - URL switches persist across navigation and disable cleanly after removal

parameters.script: const before={url:location.href,historyLength:history.length}; const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('a')]; const newExpense=links.find(a=>(a.textContent||'').trim()==='New Expense' && a.getAttribute('href')?.includes('/expenses/new')); if(!newExpense) return {before,error:'New Expense link not found'}; newExpense.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const afterNew={url:location.href,historyLength:history.length,body:(document.body?.innerText||'').slice(0,1500)}; const expenses=[...document.querySelectorAll('a')].find(a=>(a.textContent||'').trim()==='My Expenses' && a.getAttribute('href')?.includes('/expenses')); if(!expenses) return {before,afterNew,error:'My Expenses link not found'}; expenses.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); return {before,afterNew,afterExpenses:{url:location.href,historyLength:history.length,body:(document.body?.innerText||'').slice(0,1500)},mockPreserved:new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('mock')==='1'};
